title: Weather and Glasshouse
author: Wendell Dravenmoor
blurb: Isandro Blackwood, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
